regions.merged_text: God bless you J.J. and Win. I'd write at length .. but I just want to thank you for favor of the 8th. Thank God for M.C's change! ! He could not have received my letter befor Monday. - sent Friday on 3¢. It only heightens my hopes in God's designs . . How wonderful! . Brother Pat. has snapped out of dange. . Deo Gr.
